newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks revive in thin early trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks revive in thin early trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks revived in early Tuesday morning trade after the key benchmark had posted losses on Monday for a third straight session, brokers said.
But they said trade was thin and the upswing was mostly technical in a market still lacking factors to encourage buying.
After 25 minutes of trade the Nikkei average of 225 leading shares was up 137.71 points or 0.70 percent at 19,842.88. Its September futures were 80 points higher at 19,850.
"Some high-techs are recovering, lending support to the market," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said. "But how long the rise will last remains to be seen."
